world.miniboss_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.miniboss_cleared.text: Only a clean breeze left. The trial is past.

world.scar_cleared.speaker: Thought
world.scar_cleared.text: Its appetite closed. I didn't feed it.

world.mirror_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.mirror_cleared.text: Only your reflection is left in the Mirror Hall.

world.mirror_cleared.speaker: Thought
world.mirror_cleared.text: The true shadow is heavier—then walk with weight.

world.wreck_cleared.speaker: Narration
world.wreck_cleared.text: The wreck is quiet. Waves knock the keel.

world.wreck_cleared.speaker: Thought
world.wreck_cleared.text: The captain sleeps. The pass… is reaching shore alive.

world.road_note.speaker: Notice Board
world.road_note.text: No soup at the inn. Leave the nest under the bridge alone.

world.road_note.speaker: Notice Board
world.road_note.text: The graveyard lamp went out. Light it if you have fire.

world.grave_b.speaker: Narration
world.grave_b.text: Dried flowers before the old stone. A copper coin holds them.

world.grave_b.speaker: Thought
world.grave_b.text: Someone came. The village isn't wholly empty.

world.scare_field.speaker: Narration
world.scare_field.text: Rations in the scarecrow's cap. For the birds.

world.scare_field.speaker: Narration
world.scare_field.text: Crooked writing on the brim: don't eat Wheatear's.

world.camp_ash_road.speaker: Narration
world.camp_ash_road.text: The embers are still warm. There's a city east.

world.camp_ash_road.speaker: Thought
world.camp_ash_road.text: Someone just left. Small prints—in a hurry too.

region.mist_locked.speaker: System
region.mist_locked.text: The mist is still far. Raise your blade at the Knight Keep first.

region.dojo_warn.speaker: System
region.dojo_warn.text: The dojo is heavy. Power 26+ suggested (you: {power}).

region.forest_warn.speaker: System
region.forest_warn.text: The forest wind runs fast. Power 30+ suggested (you: {power}).

region.coast_warn.speaker: System
region.coast_warn.text: The shore waves are heavy. Power 30+ suggested (you: {power}).
